entries.zh: 慌；慌张急遽、匆忙失措之状
entries.en: hastily; in a flurried, hurried manner

entries.zh: 慌忙；仓促草率、欠斟酌地行事（sin tiento 谓不加斟酌）
entries.en: hastily and heedlessly; without care or caution

entries.zh: 慌迫；急迫催逼、过分催促纠缠（importunamente）
entries.en: in urgent haste; urging importunately, pressing with undue speed

entries.zh: 吟；吟诵课文、按调咏读（acentuar la lección 指吟诵经课）
entries.en: to chant or intone the lesson; to recite with proper accent

entries.zh: 使音声如金玉；字音抑扬悦耳、润饰语音
entries.en: to accent the voices so they sound like gold and jade; to give melodious accent to speech
entries.notes: M 栏较 H 栏多一音节（疑为『聲』），据「金玉音聲」之美义与西语 acentuar las voces 判定。

entries.zh: 修整使光洁；刨光或敲打（鉋／敲二字待定）
entries.en: to smooth or polish (by planing or knocking; Han character uncertain: 鉋 plane / 敲 knock)
entries.notes: 汉字栏作[疑:鉋/敲]，二字皆合修整之义，暂据 M/R 音写并存两读。

entries.zh: 鉋刀；修整木石使光洁之刀具（或作『敲刀』，前字待定）
entries.en: a plane (smoothing tool); knife for smoothing work
entries.notes: 承上条[疑:鉋/敲]；与『刀』组合，鉋刀（刨具）解更顺。

entries.zh: 做白地；打磨刷拭至洁白净底，修整光洁
entries.en: to polish neatly; to bring a surface to a clean white finish
to accept the promise; to undertake, take on
to receive and accept (the promise); to bear, take upon oneself

entries.zh: 私；偏袒徇私（对人另眼相待）
entries.en: partiality; favoring of persons, selfish bias
entries.notes: M 栏多出「lay giáᶜ」两音节未识；R 栏对音 zǔ 与 私（sī）不合，疑有讹，余三栏互证。

entries.en: partiality; a partial or selfish heart
entries.notes: R 栏首字对音 zǔ 沿上条疑讹；H/M/L 三栏互证清晰。

entries.zh: 大小心；待人分大小、厚此薄彼之心
entries.en: favoritism; a heart that treats people unequally (lit. big-small heart)

entries.zh: 厚薄心；待人分厚薄、有偏私之心
entries.en: favoritism; a heart that measures thick and thin toward different people
to hit (the mark); to get it right, succeed

entries.zh: 正合其意；中人口味、恰投所好
entries.en: to suit one's taste; to hit exactly what pleases
entries.notes: H 栏「執个」二字释义未安，据西语 acertar con el gusto 与『着』（得中）义判为契合喜好。

entries.en: to guess correctly; (of divination) to prove accurate
to hit the target; to strike the bull's-eye
